name: Nightmare
description: A creature type for terrifying monsters or evil spirits created by the unconscious mind, primarily black.

description_citations.text: "Nightmare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nightmares begin manifesting on Eldraine as a consequence of Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber, often taking the shape of the Phyrexian invaders.
timeline.quote: Nightmares began manifesting on Eldraine as a consequence of Ashiok's involvement in the Wicked Slumber .

citation.text: "Nightmare", section "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's actions cause nightmares to manifest in reality on Theros.
timeline.quote: As a consequence of the actions of Ashiok, Nightmares manifested in reality on Theros .

citation.text: "Nightmare", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A tentacled nightmare crawls from the basement wall toward Jace and Kaito.
timeline.quote: some terrible, shapeless, tentacled thing began to crawl out and into the room where they both stood.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace reads the nightmare's mind and says it is a nightmare given substance.
timeline.quote: This is a nightmare given substance.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito deflects its tentacle with a wall of floor debris.
timeline.quote: the little flecks of stone that littered the floor rose up in a wall of debris that blocked the strike

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Jace dissolves the nightmare by taking away the dreamers' fear.
timeline.quote: I reached into the dreamers I felt inside it and took their fears away.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.

relations.quote: the ability to make them manifest in reality

citation.text: "Nightmare", section "Ashiok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: the House spawns nightmares through his influence
relations.quote: spawned by the House because of the demon Valgavoth 's influence

citation.text: "Nightmare", section "Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A tentacled gelatinous being with ghostly heads in its mouth that Jace dissolves by removing the dreamers' fear.

citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2024.
